item.title: Flytipping. Has been reported many times. They are still there as of this evening., 15th September
item.description:
I have reported this Flytipping several times. Some of them were removed and the remaining left behind. Located on the left side on entering Owen close. These are not new ones, they are the old ones. The general waste bin men refused to empty the rubbish in the blue top bin. I am getting frustrated reporting this so many times and not is fully done. This did not happen early in the year. I am suspecting who ever is doing this must be new in the area. This is from the residents of Malthus path and not Owen close. Please kindly educate residents especially the new one that they should put the right rubbish in the right bin. Please act. Thank you. 31 Owen close

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Owen Close, Thamesmead
Report on FixMyStreet
